repos.name: Laboratory_managment-system-DBMS-
repos.description: The Laboratory Management System is a web-based application designed to manage various aspects of a medical laboratory including patient records, doctor information, appointments, tests, lab results, billing, inventory, and pitfalls tracking. The system provides a RESTful API backend with authentication and a static frontend interface.

repos.name: Smart-Energy-Meter
repos.description: A connected energy monitoring device that measures real-time power consumption and transmits data to a web or mobile interface. It helps detect abnormal usage, calculate cost, and promote efficient energy management.

repos.name: Fingerprint-Door-Lock-System
repos.description: A biometric door access system that unlocks only when an authorized fingerprint is scanned. It enhances security by eliminating traditional keys and can log access data using IoT integration.

repos.name: Heart-Rate-Monitoring-System
repos.description: A health monitoring device that uses a pulse or MAX30102 sensor to measure heart rate and SpO₂ levels. The readings are transmitted to an IoT platform for remote health tracking and early detection of abnormalities.
